nb9e4bbf456.headline: Esade predicts 2% growth of the Spanish economy in 2019
nb9e4bbf456.summary: Esade forecasts Spain's GDP growth to slow to 2% in 2019 due to external risks including protectionist trade policies, financial tensions, and high global debt levels.
nb9e4bbf456.why: Spain is a major Eurozone economy, and its growth outlook affects regional economic sentiment and investment flows.

n71c4f00c74.headline: Egypt sees more pound volatility after repatriation fund ends
n71c4f00c74.summary: The end of Egypt’s repatriation fund has led to increased volatility in the Egyptian pound, affecting foreign investment and currency markets.
n71c4f00c74.why: Currency stability is crucial for Egypt’s economic reforms and attracting foreign direct investment.
